definition_en: large in size, important, or older
core_image: 一头大象堵住了整条小路
scene: 大象慢慢走过来，把小路占满了。A big elephant blocked the narrow path.
sceneCN: 这里 big 是「大的」（第 1 个义项：体积或占地规模大）；句意是一头大象堵住了窄路。

pos.zh: 形容词：大的；重要的；年长的

derivatives.zh: 由 big 加 -g- 与 -ish 构成，义为「略大的」
由 big 加 -ie 构成，口语指「大事、大人物」

senses.title: Large in size
senses.definition: large in size or amount
senses.definitionCN: 体积或数量大
senses.example: A big elephant blocked the narrow path.
senses.exampleCN: 一头大象堵住了窄路。
senses.why: This is the basic sense, measured against ordinary things.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本义，与普通大小相比而言。

senses.title: Important or serious
senses.definition: important or having a strong effect
senses.definitionCN: 重要或影响很大的
senses.example: This is a big decision for the family.
senses.exampleCN: 这对这个家庭是个重大决定。
senses.why: Things that matter loom large in the mind, so size words became value words.
senses.whyCN: 重要的事在脑中显得巨大，于是尺寸词转为价值词。

senses.title: Older
senses.definition: older, used of siblings
senses.definitionCN: 指兄弟姐妹中年长的
senses.example: My big brother taught me to swim.
senses.exampleCN: 我哥哥教我游泳。
senses.why: An older child is bigger, so size stood for age in the family.
senses.whyCN: 年长的孩子个子更大，于是尺寸在家庭里代指年龄。

intro.en: Big appeared in northern English in the Middle Ages with an unclear origin.
intro.cn: big 在中世纪出现于英格兰北部，确切来源不明。

items.en: big meant strong or stout.
items.cn: big 意为「强壮、结实」。

items.en: the word spread south for large size.
items.cn: 这个词向南传播，表示「尺寸大」。

items.en: big also meant important.
items.cn: big 也开始表示「重要」。

items.en: big brother named an older brother.
items.cn: big brother 指哥哥。

items.en: big doubles its g before -er and -est.
items.cn: 如今 big 加 -er、-est 时双写 g。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one vowel; the near-meaning group gives size words.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个元音；近义组是表示大小的词。

normalIntro.en: Big covers size, importance and the older brother at once.
normalIntro.cn: big 同时覆盖尺寸、重要性与哥哥这三层。

normal.en: The comparative doubles the g: bigger.
normal.cn: 比较级要双写 g：bigger。

normal.en: Big deal often sounds dismissive.
normal.cn: big deal 常带不以为然的语气。

normal.en: Big also means important.
normal.cn: big 也能表示「重要」。

normal.en: Big brother means an older brother.
normal.cn: big brother 指哥哥。

normal.en: The word is short and ends in a hard g.
normal.cn: 这个词很短，以硬音 g 收尾。

abstract.en: See a huge elephant filling a path.
abstract.cn: 想象大象塞满整条小路。

abstract.en: See a wide door beside a small one.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇大门挨着小门。

abstract.en: See an older brother holding a hand.
abstract.cn: 想象哥哥牵着一只手。

examples.en: A big elephant blocked the narrow path.
examples.cn: 一头大象堵住了窄路。

examples.en: This is a big decision for the family.
examples.cn: 这对这个家庭是个重大决定。

examples.en: My big brother taught me to swim.
examples.cn: 我哥哥教我游泳。

dict_mnemonic.text: big 的 b 像鼓起的肚子，g 像撑开的腿，整个词就是「大」。

root: 中古英语出现于英格兰北部，本义「强壮、结实」，十四世纪南传后转指「尺寸大」，十六世纪起引申为「重要」，近代又用于兄弟姐妹中的年长者。

sensesIntro.en: Size, importance and seniority all look big to the eye.
sensesIntro.cn: 尺寸、重要性、年长，在眼里都显得「大」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a huge elephant filling a path.
core.cn: 核心意象：塞满小路的大象。

intro.en: Big doubles its g before -er and -est, and takes -ish and -ie.
intro.cn: big 加 -er、-est 时双写 g，也能加 -ish、-ie。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the origin of the word is uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，这个词的来源并不确定。

definition_en: a bicycle or motorcycle
core_image: 车棚里挤满学生的自行车
scene: 车棚里挤满学生的自行车。She left her bike by the gate.
sceneCN: 这里 bike 是「自行车」（第 1 个义项：两轮脚踏车的口语说法）；句意是她把车停在了门边。

pos.zh: 名词：自行车；摩托车（口语）

derivatives.zh: 由 bike 加 -er 构成，义为「骑车人」
由 bike 加 -ing 构成，义为「骑行活动」
bike 的完整形式，义为「自行车」

senses.title: A bicycle
senses.definition: a bicycle, in everyday speech
senses.definitionCN: 日常口语中的自行车
senses.example: She left her bike by the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 她把自行车停在了门边。
senses.why: This is a clipped form of bicycle, used in casual talk.
senses.whyCN: 这是 bicycle 的截短形式，多用于随便的口语。

senses.title: A motorcycle
senses.definition: a motorcycle, especially in American use
senses.definitionCN: 尤指美式用法中的摩托车
senses.example: He rode his bike down the highway.
senses.exampleCN: 他骑着摩托上了公路。
senses.why: The short word widened from pedals to engines.
senses.whyCN: 这个短词从脚踏车扩大到带发动机的车。

senses.title: To ride a bike
senses.definition: to travel by bicycle
senses.definitionCN: 骑自行车出行
senses.example: We biked along the river.
senses.exampleCN: 我们沿河骑车。
senses.why: The noun became a verb for the activity.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词，表示这项活动。

intro.en: Bike is a nineteenth-century shortening of bicycle.
intro.cn: bike 是十九世纪对 bicycle 的截短。

items.en: bike appeared as slang for bicycle.
items.cn: bike 作为自行车的俚语出现。

items.en: the short word spread with safety bicycles.
items.cn: 随着安全型自行车普及，这个短词流行。

items.en: bike also covered motorcycles.
items.cn: bike 也开始指摩托车。

items.en: mountain bikes gave the word new life.
items.cn: 山地车让这个词重获活力。

items.en: bike is common in speech and signs.
items.cn: 如今 bike 常见于口语和标识。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one letter; the near-meaning group gives cycling words.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个字母；近义组是骑行相关词。

entries.definition: a long walk in the country

normalIntro.en: Bike is bicycle cut short for quick speech.
normalIntro.cn: bike 是 bicycle 为说话省力而截短的。

normal.en: The plural is bikes.
normal.cn: 复数是 bikes。

normal.en: By bike means travelling on a bike.
normal.cn: by bike 指骑自行车前往。

normal.en: A bike lane is marked for bikes.
normal.cn: bike lane 是给自行车划的道。

normal.en: In America a bike can mean a motorbike.
normal.cn: 在美式用法里 bike 也可指摩托。

normal.en: The verb is biked in the past.
normal.cn: 动词过去式是 biked。

abstract.en: See a crowded school bike shed.
abstract.cn: 想象挤满自行车的车棚。

abstract.en: See two wheels turning by a river.
abstract.cn: 想象河边转动的两个车轮。

abstract.en: See a helmet hung on handlebars.
abstract.cn: 想象挂在车把上的头盔。

examples.en: She left her bike by the gate.
examples.cn: 她把自行车停在了门边。

examples.en: He rode his bike down the highway.
examples.cn: 他骑着摩托上了公路。

examples.en: We biked along the river.
examples.cn: 我们沿河骑车。

dict_mnemonic.text: bicycle 太长，说快了只剩 bike 两个音节。

root: 十九世纪由 bicycle 截短而来，先作俚语，后随安全型自行车普及；二十世纪起在美式英语中也指摩托车，二十世纪七十年代山地车又推动了它的使用。

sensesIntro.en: One short word covers bicycles, motorbikes and the ride itself.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个短词既指自行车、摩托，也指骑行的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crowded school bike shed.
core.cn: 核心意象：挤满自行车的车棚。

intro.en: Bike takes -s, -ed and -ing, and builds biker and biking.
intro.cn: bike 可加 -s、-ed、-ing，并构成 biker 与 biking。

latinIntro.en: The long form bicycle uses Latin bi- and Greek kyklos.
latinIntro.cn: 完整形式 bicycle 用拉丁语 bi- 与希腊语 kyklos。

definition_en: a statement of money owed, a proposed law, or a bird's beak
core_image: 餐馆桌角压着的那张长条账单
scene: 账单压在餐馆桌角，旁边放着找零。He paid the bill and left a tip.
sceneCN: 这里 bill 是「账单」（第 1 个义项：列出应付金额的单据）；句意是他付了账单并留下小费。

derivatives.zh: 由 bill 加 -ing 构成，义为「开票、计费」
由 bill 与 board 复合，义为「广告牌」

senses.title: A statement of money owed
senses.definition: a paper listing money that must be paid
senses.definitionCN: 列出应付金额的单据
senses.example: He paid the bill and left a tip.
senses.exampleCN: 他付了账单并留下小费。
senses.why: This comes from a word for a sealed document.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项来自表示「盖印文书」的词。

senses.title: A proposed law
senses.definition: a draft law put before a parliament
senses.definitionCN: 提交议会审议的法律草案
senses.example: The bill passed after a long debate.
senses.exampleCN: 经过长时间辩论，法案通过了。
senses.why: A bill was once a royal document, so laws kept the name.
senses.whyCN: bill 曾是皇家文书，法律沿用了这个名字。

senses.title: A bird's beak
senses.definition: the hard mouth of a bird
senses.definitionCN: 鸟类坚硬的嘴
senses.example: The bird cleaned its bill on the branch.
senses.exampleCN: 鸟在树枝上擦拭喙。
senses.why: This sense has a separate Old English root, bile.
senses.whyCN: 这个义项另有古英语词根 bile。

intro.en: Bill joins two histories: a Latin document and an Old English beak.
intro.cn: bill 汇合了两条历史：拉丁语的文书与古英语的鸟喙。

items.en: bulla meant a sealed document.
items.cn: bulla 意为「盖印文书」。

items.en: billa named a written list.
items.cn: billa 指书面清单。

items.en: bill meant a note of money owed.
items.cn: bill 指欠款单据。

items.en: parliament used bill for a draft law.
items.cn: 议会用 bill 指法律草案。

items.en: bile meant a bird's beak.
items.cn: 古英语 bile 指鸟喙。

items.en: both senses live on in one spelling.
items.cn: 两个义项在同一个拼写里并存。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one letter; the near-meaning group gives payment words.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个字母；近义组是付款相关词。

entries.definition: a list of goods and money due

normalIntro.en: Bill is paper that asks for money, paper that proposes law, and a bird's hard mouth.
normalIntro.cn: bill 既是要钱的纸、提议法律的纸，也是鸟的硬嘴。

normal.en: The plural is bills.
normal.cn: 复数是 bills。

normal.en: Pay the bill at the counter.
normal.cn: 到柜台付账。

normal.en: A bill can also be a draft law.
normal.cn: bill 也可以指法律草案。

normal.en: A bird's bill is its beak.
normal.cn: 鸟的 bill 就是喙。

normal.en: Billed means charged or advertised.
normal.cn: billed 指被收费或被宣传。

abstract.en: See a long paper slip under a cup.
abstract.cn: 想象杯子下压着的长条单据。

abstract.en: See hands raised to vote on a law.
abstract.cn: 想象举手对法律表决。

abstract.en: See a sparrow wiping its beak.
abstract.cn: 想象麻雀擦拭它的喙。

examples.en: He paid the bill and left a tip.
examples.cn: 他付了账单并留下小费。

examples.en: The bill passed after a long debate.
examples.cn: 经过长时间辩论，法案通过了。

examples.en: The bird cleaned its bill on the branch.
examples.cn: 鸟在树枝上擦拭喙。

dict_mnemonic.text: bill 像一张窄长的纸条，正是一张账单的形状。

root: 表示账单与法案的 bill 源自拉丁语 bulla（盖印文书），经中世纪拉丁语 billa 进入英语；表示鸟喙的 bill 则来自古英语 bile，两条来源合流为同一拼写。

sensesIntro.en: One spelling carries a debt note, a draft law and a bird's mouth.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一个拼写承载欠款单、法律草案与鸟嘴三个义项。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long paper slip under a cup.
core.cn: 核心意象：杯子下压着的长条单据。

intro.en: Bill takes -s, -ed and -ing, and joins board to form billboard.
intro.cn: bill 可加 -s、-ed、-ing，还能与 board 复合成 billboard。

latinIntro.en: The document sense comes from Latin bulla; the beak sense is Old English.
latinIntro.cn: 文书义来自拉丁语 bulla，鸟喙义来自古英语。

definition_en: a container for storing things or for waste
core_image: 厨房角落装着菜叶的桶
scene: 厨房角落的桶里堆着菜叶。He threw the peel into the bin.
sceneCN: 这里 bin 是「垃圾桶」（第 2 个义项：盛放废弃物的容器）；句意是他把果皮扔进了垃圾桶。

pos.zh: 动词：把……扔进垃圾桶；丢弃

derivatives.zh: 由 bin 与 man 复合，英式英语指「垃圾清运工」
由 dust 与 bin 复合，英式英语指「垃圾桶」

senses.title: A storage container
senses.definition: a container for keeping things in
senses.definitionCN: 用来存放物品的容器
senses.example: Store the rice in a dry bin.
senses.exampleCN: 把米存放在干燥的箱子里。
senses.why: This is the older sense, a simple basket or box.
senses.whyCN: 这是较早的义项，指简单的筐或箱。

senses.title: A waste container
senses.definition: a container for things thrown away
senses.definitionCN: 盛放废弃物的容器
senses.example: He threw the peel into the bin.
senses.exampleCN: 他把果皮扔进了垃圾桶。
senses.why: The same container became the place for rubbish at home.
senses.whyCN: 同一种容器在家里成了丢废弃物的地方。

senses.title: To throw something away
senses.definition: to put something in the bin
senses.definitionCN: 把某物扔进垃圾桶
senses.example: They binned the old papers.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把旧文件丢了。
senses.why: The container became a verb for the act of discarding.
senses.whyCN: 容器转为动词，表示丢弃的动作。

intro.en: Bin is an Old English word for a basket, probably from Latin.
intro.cn: bin 是古英语中表示筐的词，可能源自拉丁语。

items.en: binne meant a basket or crib.
items.cn: binne 意为「筐、储物格」。

items.en: bins held grain and coal.
items.cn: 箱筐用来装谷物和煤。

items.en: bin named a household rubbish container.
items.cn: bin 指家庭垃圾桶。

items.en: recycling bins appeared in cities.
items.cn: 回收箱出现在城市里。

items.en: bin also works as a verb.
items.cn: 如今 bin 也作动词使用。

note.en: The look-alike group differs by one vowel; the near-meaning group gives containers.
note.cn: 形近组只差一个元音；近义组是各类容器。

entries.definition: a container made of woven material

normalIntro.en: A bin holds things, and later holds what we throw away.
normalIntro.cn: bin 先用来装东西，后来装我们丢掉的东西。

normal.en: The plural is bins.
normal.cn: 复数是 bins。

normal.en: A rubbish bin is for waste.
normal.cn: rubbish bin 用来装垃圾。

normal.en: A bin liner keeps the bin clean.
normal.cn: bin liner 让桶保持干净。

normal.en: The verb binned means threw away.
normal.cn: 动词 binned 指丢掉了。

normal.en: British English prefers bin to trash can.
normal.cn: 英式英语更常说 bin。

abstract.en: See vegetable peel piled in a kitchen bin.
abstract.cn: 想象厨房桶里堆着菜叶。

abstract.en: See three coloured bins by a gate.
abstract.cn: 想象门口三只不同颜色的桶。

abstract.en: See a hand dropping paper into a bin.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把纸丢进桶里。

examples.en: He threw the peel into the bin.
examples.cn: 他把果皮扔进了垃圾桶。

examples.en: Store the rice in a dry bin.
examples.cn: 把米存放在干燥的箱子里。

examples.en: They binned the old papers.
examples.cn: 他们把旧文件丢了。

dict_mnemonic.text: bin 的 b 与 n 像桶的两道壁，中间装东西。

root: 古英语 binne 指筐或储物格，可能借自拉丁语；中古英语用来装谷物与煤，十九世纪起指家庭垃圾桶，二十世纪出现分类回收箱，并发展出动词用法。

sensesIntro.en: The same container stores grain and receives rubbish.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一种容器，既存放谷物，也接收垃圾。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: vegetable peel piled in a kitchen bin.
core.cn: 核心意象：厨房桶里堆着菜叶。

intro.en: Bin doubles its n before -ed and -ing, and joins man and dust.
intro.cn: bin 加 -ed、-ing 要双写 n，并能与 man、dust 复合。

latinIntro.en: The word is Old English, possibly from Latin benna.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词来自古英语，可能源自拉丁语 benna。

definition_zh: 鸟；一只鸟或一种鸟；禽类（供食用或狩猎）；羽毛球；（口语）年轻女子；飞行器（行话）
definition_en: a feathered animal with wings and a beak, or one of the many things English names after it, from a table bird to a shuttlecock to an aircraft
core_image: 一只麻雀停在篱笆顶上，胸羽蓬起，下一瞬就要振翅
scene: 厨房的炉火边，铁钩上的整禽慢慢转着，油脂一滴一滴落进下方的托盘。 The bird had been turning over the fire since noon, and its skin had gone the colour of amber.
sceneCN: 这里 bird 是「供食用的禽类」（第 3 个义项：宰杀后整只上炉的禽）；句意：那只禽从中午起就在火上转着，皮已经变成琥珀色。

pos.zh: 鸟；禽类；羽毛球；（口语）年轻女子
（口语）观鸟；到野外观察并记录鸟类

derivatives.zh: 观鸟者
观鸟活动
小鸟；羽毛球
似鸟的
鸟舍

senses.title: The Feathered Class
senses.definition: the group of warm-blooded, egg-laying animals that have feathers, wings and a beak
senses.definitionCN: 有羽毛、翅膀与喙的温血卵生动物这一类群
senses.example: The feather is what separates a bird from every other living animal.
senses.exampleCN: 羽毛是把鸟与其他一切现存动物区分开的东西。
senses.why: the class is defined by feathers, so the word can name the whole group before it names any member.
senses.whyCN: 这一纲由羽毛界定，因此这个词可以先指整个类群，再指其中成员。

senses.title: One Individual or One Species
senses.definition: a single animal of that class, or a species counted as one unit
senses.definitionCN: 该类群中的一只动物，或作为一个单位计数的某个物种
senses.example: A single bird sang from the top of the hedge for most of the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 一只鸟在篱笆顶上唱了大半个上午。
senses.why: once the class has a name, any member can take it, and counting turns a species into a unit as easily as an individual.
senses.whyCN: 类群有了名字，任一成员都能用它；计数时物种也像个体一样成为单位。

senses.title: A Table Bird or Game Bird
senses.definition: a bird raised or hunted to be eaten
senses.definitionCN: 为食用而饲养或猎取的禽类
senses.example: They roasted a whole bird for the family dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为家宴烤了一整只禽。
senses.why: the animal's body becomes food, and English keeps the animal's name for the meat on the table.
senses.whyCN: 动物的身体变成食物，英语仍用动物之名来指桌上的肉。

senses.title: Dated British: A Young Woman
senses.definition: dated British slang for a young woman, once common and now avoided
senses.definitionCN: 英式旧时俚语，指年轻女子，曾经流行，如今已少用
senses.example: In the old comedy, the young bird outwits her guardian and marries whom she likes.
senses.exampleCN: 在那部老喜剧里，那位年轻姑娘骗过监护人，嫁给了自己中意的人。
senses.why: the slang borrows the smallness and liveliness of a bird, a common pattern in affectionate words for young people.
senses.whyCN: 俚语借用了鸟的娇小与活泼，这是称呼年轻人时常见的亲昵造词模式。

senses.title: The Shuttlecock
senses.definition: the feathered projectile struck across the net in badminton
senses.definitionCN: 羽毛球运动中击过球网的羽制小球
senses.example: The bird clipped the net and dropped on her side of the court.
senses.exampleCN: 羽毛球擦过网，落在她这一侧的场地上。
senses.why: the shuttlecock is a cork weighted with feathers, so the animal's name passed to the object that flies like one.
senses.whyCN: 羽毛球是软木托加羽毛，动物之名于是转给了那个像鸟一样飞的东西。

senses.title: Slang for an Aircraft
senses.definition: informal, of a plane, rocket or satellite, treated as a machine with a personality
senses.definitionCN: 口语用法，指飞机、火箭或卫星，把它当作有脾气的机器
senses.example: The pilot patted the fuselage and called the old bird steady.
senses.exampleCN: 飞行员拍了拍机身，说这架老飞机还算稳当。
senses.why: a machine that flies invites the same metaphor as the animal that flies, and pilots shorten it to one syllable.
senses.whyCN: 会飞的机器自然借用会飞的动物的比喻，飞行员又把它缩成一个音节。

senses.title: Give Someone the Bird
senses.definition: in the phrase give someone the bird, to jeer at a performer or to dismiss a person abruptly
senses.definitionCN: 用于一个意为「给某人一只鸟」的固定短语，指对表演者喝倒彩，或突然把人解雇、赶走
senses.example: The audience gave the singer the bird after the second verse.
senses.exampleCN: 观众在第二段唱完后对歌手喝了倒彩。
senses.why: the phrase began as theatre slang for hissing an actor off the stage, and the bird here is a sound rather than an animal.
senses.whyCN: 这一短语原为剧院俚语，指用嘘声把演员赶下台，这里的 bird 是一种声音，而非动物。

senses.title: A Bird in the Hand
senses.titleCN: 谚语：手中之物胜过未得之物
senses.definition: in the proverb a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush, what you already hold is safer than what you hope to gain
senses.definitionCN: 用于一句关于猎鸟的古老谚语，意为手中已有之物比希望得到之物更可靠
senses.example: He took the modest offer, remembering that a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush.
senses.exampleCN: 他接受了那个不大的提议，记着手中一鸟胜过林中两鸟。
senses.why: the proverb is a hunting image: the bird you hold cannot escape, while the ones in the bush still can.
senses.whyCN: 这条谚语是一个狩猎画面：手里的鸟跑不掉，灌木丛里的还可能飞走。

intro.en: Bird comes from Old English bridd, a word for a young bird or nestling. Its earlier origin is unknown and no Indo-European root can be reconstructed with confidence. In Middle English it displaced fowl as the general word. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: bird 来自古英语 bridd，指幼鸟、雏鸟。它更早的来源不确定，无法可靠重构出印欧词根。中古英语时期它取代 fowl 成为通称。年代均为约数。

items.en: Bridd is recorded in Old English with the sense 'young bird, nestling'; it did not yet mean the class as a whole.
items.cn: bridd 在古英语中有记录，意为「幼鸟、雏鸟」，当时还不指整个类群。

items.en: In Middle English bird widened from the nestling to any bird, and by the end of the period it had replaced fowl as the everyday word.
items.cn: 中古英语时期，bird 从雏鸟扩大为任何鸟，到该时期末已在日常语中取代 fowl。

items.en: Fowl, the older general word, shrank to mean farmyard poultry and the meat from them.
items.cn: fowl 这个更早的通称缩小为指农家饲养的家禽及其肉。

items.en: Source uncertain: the pre-Old-English origin of bridd is unknown, and proposed links with other Germanic words are not accepted as settled.
items.cn: 来源不确定：bridd 在古英语之前的来历不明，与其他日耳曼语词的关联假说均未成为定论。

items.en: The table sense, the dated sense 'young woman' and the badminton sense all appear in later centuries, each by its own metaphor.
items.cn: 餐桌义、「年轻女子」旧义与羽毛球义都出现在更晚的世纪，各自循自己的比喻而来。

items.en: The aircraft sense belongs to the twentieth century, when flying machines made the old metaphor available again.
items.cn: 飞行器义属于二十世纪，当飞行机器让这个旧比喻重新可用时出现。

note.en: Group one holds spellings and neighbours that look like bird, only one of which is the same word. Group two holds the words whose meanings touch bird without sharing its origin.
note.cn: 第一组是与 bird 形近的拼写与邻词，其中只有一个是同一个词；第二组是含义触及 bird 但不同源的词。

entries.definition: An archaic spelling of bird, also used for a woman; it is the same word with a different vowel letter, not a separate root.
entries.definitionCN: bird 的古旧拼法，也曾用来指女子；它是同一个词换了元音字母，并非另一个词根。

entries.definition: A woman about to be married, from Old English bryd; it looks close to bird but has its own root and no connection.
entries.definitionCN: 即将成婚的女子，来自古英语 bryd；外形接近 bird，却有独立词根，并无关联。

entries.definition: A thin nail, from a Germanic word for a spike; it shares three letters with bird and nothing else.
entries.definitionCN: 一种细钉，来自日耳曼语中指尖刺的词；与 bird 只共享三个字母，别无其他。

entries.definition: Bird plus the diminutive -ie, used for a small bird, a shuttlecock, or one stroke under par in golf.
entries.definitionCN: bird 加指小后缀 -ie，可指小鸟、羽毛球，或高尔夫中低于标准杆一杆的成绩。

entries.definition: The older general word that bird displaced; it now means poultry or game birds rather than the whole class.
entries.definitionCN: 被 bird 取代的更早通称；如今指家禽或猎禽，而非整个类群。

entries.definition: The formal adjective for anything to do with birds, from Latin avis; it has no connection with bird.
entries.definitionCN: 指与鸟有关的正式形容词，来自拉丁 avis；与 bird 没有关联。

entries.definition: Domesticated birds kept for eggs and meat; it covers only the farmyard part of bird.
entries.definitionCN: 为蛋与肉而饲养的家禽；只覆盖 bird 中农家饲养的那一部分。

entries.definition: A young bird not yet able to fly, which is close to what Old English bridd first meant.
entries.definitionCN: 还不能飞的幼鸟，接近古英语 bridd 最早的意思。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Old English word, the real historical shift from fowl, and the real phrases that fix each later sense.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的古英语词、真实发生的从 fowl 到 bird 的替换，以及固定各个后起义项的真实短语。

normal.en: Old English bridd meant a nestling; the modern word still keeps that smallness in birdie.
normal.cn: 古英语 bridd 指雏鸟；现代词仍把这份娇小留在 birdie 里。

normal.en: Bird replaced fowl at the same time that fowl narrowed to the farmyard.
normal.cn: bird 取代 fowl 的同时，fowl 恰好缩小到农家院落。

normal.en: The feather fixes the class: no other living animal has one.
normal.cn: 羽毛界定了这一纲：其他现存动物都没有。

normal.en: Badminton, aircraft and audiences all borrowed the same flying image.
normal.cn: 羽毛球、飞行器与观众都借用了同一个飞翔的意象。

normal.en: The proverb keeps the hunting scene: one held, two still in the bush.
normal.cn: 谚语保留狩猎场景：一鸟在手，两鸟仍在灌木丛。

abstract.en: Picture a small body on a fence post, feathers lifted, weight already shifting to leave.
abstract.cn: 想象篱笆柱上的一个小身体，羽毛竖起，重心已在准备离开。

abstract.en: Picture a shuttlecock turning in the air, feathers first and cork behind.
abstract.cn: 想象一只羽毛球在空中翻转，羽毛在前，软木在后。

abstract.en: Picture a hand closing on one bird while two others rise from a hedge.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手攥住一只鸟，另外两只从树篱里飞起。

examples.en: The island has no native bird that cannot fly.
examples.cn: 这座岛上没有不会飞的本土鸟类。

examples.en: Bird song changes with the season and with the hour.
examples.cn: 鸟鸣随季节与时辰而变化。

examples.en: He has watched the same bird return to the same branch for four springtimes.
examples.cn: 他眼看着同一只鸟连续四个春天回到同一根枝条。

dict_mnemonic.text: 谐音「伯德」——球场上被拍子抽来抽去的那只小东西，先是鸟，后来成了羽毛球。

root: 古英语 bridd「幼鸟、雏鸟」，中古英语扩大为「鸟」并取代 fowl；词源不确定，没有可可靠重构的印欧词根，不宜拆成若干字母词根。

sensesIntro.en: The eight senses start from a small feathered animal: the class it belongs to, one of its members, its body on a table, a slang name for a young woman, a shuttlecock, an aircraft, a jeering phrase, and a proverb about holding what you have.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一只覆羽的小动物出发：它所属的类群、其中一个成员、它上桌的身体、指年轻女子的旧俚语、羽毛球、飞行器、一句喝倒彩的话，以及一句劝人守住手中之物的谚语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small feathered body ready to leave its perch.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个覆着羽毛的小身体，随时准备离枝。

branches.en: THE CLASS AND ITS MEMBER: a name for the group becomes a name for one of them.
branches.cn: 类群与成员：类群之名变成其中一个的名字。

branches.en: BODY USED AS THING: the animal becomes food, and its feathers become a game piece.
branches.cn: 身体转为物件：动物变成食物，羽毛变成球具。

branches.en: BORROWED SMALLNESS: a lively young woman is called by the small creature's name.
branches.cn: 借来的娇小：活泼的年轻女子被冠以小动物的名字。

branches.en: MACHINE THAT FLIES: the metaphor moves from feathers to metal.
branches.cn: 会飞的机器：比喻从羽毛移到金属。

branches.en: VOICE AND PRUDENCE: one phrase hisses, the other warns against letting go.
branches.cn: 声音与谨慎：一个短语发出嘘声，另一个告诫人别放手。

intro.en: Bird is a free-standing Old English word with no productive prefix or root; the pieces below are real English compounds and suffixes attached to it, not Latin or Greek segments.
intro.cn: bird 是一个独立的古英语词，没有可拆分的前缀或词根；下面列出的都是真实附加在它上面的英语复合成分与后缀，而非拉丁或希腊语素。

latinIntro.en: No reliable Latin or Greek cognate exists: Latin avis 'bird' and Greek ornis are different words with different roots, and treating them as a family here would be invention.
latinIntro.cn: 没有可靠的拉丁或希腊同族词：拉丁 avis「鸟」与希腊 ornis 都是词根不同的另一些词，把它们当作同族便是编造。

items.example: The word stands alone and takes suffixes directly.
items.exampleCN: 这个词可独立使用，并直接接后缀。

items.example: Birders arrive before dawn with notebooks.
items.exampleCN: 观鸟者带着笔记本在天亮前到达。

items.example: Birding counts the species seen within a set area.
items.exampleCN: 观鸟活动统计在划定区域内见到的物种。

items.meaning: a small bird, or a shuttlecock
items.example: Players on the court call the shuttlecock a birdie.
items.exampleCN: 球场上的球员把羽毛球叫作 birdie。

items.example: The dinosaur had a birdlike hip.
items.exampleCN: 那只恐龙有一副似鸟的髋部。

items.example: A birdhouse hangs from the apple tree.
items.exampleCN: 苹果树上挂着一只鸟舍。

items.meaning: a shallow basin for birds to wash in
items.example: The birdbath freezes solid in January.
items.exampleCN: 那只鸟浴盆在一月冻得结结实实。

items.meaning: a bird hunted for sport and food
items.example: Grouse and pheasant are game birds.

items.meaning: a bird that hunts live animals
items.example: The hawk is a bird of prey.

definition_en: the time when a baby comes into the world
core_image: 产房里婴儿的第一声啼哭
scene: 产房的门开了一条缝，里面传来婴儿的哭声。The nurse recorded the exact time of birth.
sceneCN: 这里 birth 是「出生」（第 1 个义项：婴儿来到世上的时刻）；句意是护士记下了出生的准确时间。

derivatives.zh: 生日，每年纪念出生的那一天
出生地，某人或某事物开始的地方
与生俱来的权利，因出身而享有的东西

senses.title: The time of being born
senses.definition: the act or moment of coming into the world
senses.definitionCN: 来到这个世界的行为或时刻
senses.example: The nurse recorded the exact time of birth.
senses.exampleCN: 护士记下了出生的准确时间。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, tied to the delivery of a child.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，与分娩这件事直接相连。

senses.title: Family origin
senses.definition: the family or social position one is born into
senses.definitionCN: 一个人出生时所处的家庭或社会地位
senses.example: She is Italian by birth.
senses.exampleCN: 她按出身是意大利人。
senses.why: Where and to whom one was born marked rank, so birth came to mean origin.
senses.whyCN: 出生地点与家庭标示身份，于是 birth 引申为出身。

senses.title: The beginning of something new
senses.definition: the start of an idea, movement or thing
senses.definitionCN: 某个想法、运动或事物的开始
senses.example: The birth of the internet changed daily life.
senses.exampleCN: 互联网的诞生改变了日常生活。
senses.why: A new thing was pictured as being born, so birth spread to beginnings.
senses.whyCN: 新事物被想象成「诞生」，于是 birth 扩展到了开端义。

abstract.en: See a family tree with many branches.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵枝杈繁多的家谱树。

abstract.en: See a small idea grow into a movement.

definition_en: the day each year when someone was born
core_image: 插满蜡烛的生日蛋糕
scene: 桌上摆着一个插满小蜡烛的蛋糕。We sang songs at her birthday party.

senses.title: The yearly day of one's birth

abstract.en: See a singer with an effortless high note.

dict_mnemonic.text: bless 与 bliss（极乐）只差一个字母，被祝福的人，心里满是喜乐。

root: bless 源自古英语 bletsian，原指献祭时以血作记的仪式，后受基督教用语影响转为「祝福」，又受拉丁语 benedicere（说好话）影响，引申为感恩与赐予好运。

sensesIntro.en: A prayer over people, a gift of good fortune, and thanks over food.

core.cn: 核心意象：教堂门口举起祝福的手。

definition_en: unable to see
core_image: 用白色手杖探路的人
scene: 他握着白色手杖，沿着墙边慢慢走。The blind man knew the street by sound.
sceneCN: 这里 blind 是「失明的」（第 1 个义项：看不见东西的）；句意是那位失明的男子靠声音认路。

derivatives.zh: 盲目地，不加判断地
失明，看不见的状态

senses.title: Unable to see
senses.definition: not able to see with the eyes
senses.definitionCN: 眼睛看不见东西的
senses.example: The blind man knew the street by sound.
senses.exampleCN: 那位失明的男子靠声音认路。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense and names the physical condition.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，直接指身体上的状况。

senses.title: Without careful judgment
senses.definition: done without thinking or checking
senses.definitionCN: 不加思考或不加核实地做
senses.example: She followed him with blind trust.
senses.exampleCN: 她怀着盲目的信任跟着他。
senses.why: Not seeing with the eyes became a picture for not seeing with the mind.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛看不见，被用来比喻心里也看不见。

senses.title: A window cover with slats
senses.definition: a cover of slats that can be pulled over a window
senses.definitionCN: 由条板组成、可以拉下来遮窗的帘子
senses.example: He pulled down the blinds before the film.
senses.exampleCN: 电影开始前他拉下了百叶窗。
senses.why: A cover that blocks sight took the name of being unable to see.
senses.whyCN: 挡住视线的遮帘，借用了「看不见」这个名字。

intro.en: Blind is an old Germanic word that spread from sight to judgment.
intro.cn: blind 是一个古老的日耳曼语词，从视力扩展到判断力。

items.en: blind meant without sight.
items.cn: blind 意为没有视力的。

items.en: blind gained the sense of lacking judgment.
items.cn: blind 获得了缺乏判断力的含义。

items.en: blinds named window screens.
items.cn: blinds 开始指窗户的遮帘。

items.en: blind spot entered everyday use.

items.en: blind covers sight, judgment and window covers.
items.cn: 如今 blind 兼指视力、判断与遮窗物。

normalIntro.en: Blind begins with the eyes and ends with the mind.
normalIntro.cn: blind 从眼睛开始，最后落在心里。

normal.en: Go blind means lose the ability to see.
normal.cn: go blind 表示失明。

normal.en: A blind spot is something you fail to notice.
normal.cn: blind spot 指自己没有察觉的地方。

normal.en: Blind faith is belief without checking.
normal.cn: blind faith 是不加核实的相信。

normal.en: Blinds cover a window.
normal.cn: blinds 是遮窗的百叶帘。

normal.en: The adverb is blindly.
normal.cn: 副词是 blindly。

abstract.en: See a white cane tapping the pavement.
abstract.cn: 想象白色手杖轻敲人行道。

abstract.en: See someone nod without looking.
abstract.cn: 想象有人没看清就点头。

abstract.en: See slats closing over a bright window.
abstract.cn: 想象条板一点点遮住明亮的窗。

examples.en: The blind man knew the street by sound.
examples.cn: 那位失明的男子靠声音认路。

root: blind 源自古英语 blind，属日耳曼语同源词，本义「看不见」；中古英语起引申为缺乏判断、盲目，十六世纪又指遮住光线的百叶帘。

sensesIntro.en: Eyes that cannot see, a mind that does not check, and a screen that blocks light.
sensesIntro.cn: 看不见的眼睛、不加核实的头脑、挡住光线的帘子。

core.cn: 核心意象：白色手杖沿墙探路。

intro.en: Blind adds -ly and -ness to make an adverb and a noun.
intro.cn: blind 加 -ly 与 -ness 构成副词和名词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Germanic; Latin items below are related in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 词基属日耳曼语，下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。

definition_en: a solid piece of material with flat sides
core_image: 堆在墙边的方形石料
scene: 墙边码着几块方形石料。A fallen tree blocked the narrow road.
sceneCN: 这里 block 是「阻挡」（第 4 个义项：使无法通过）；句意是一棵倒下的树挡住了窄路。

derivatives.zh: 堵塞，管道等被堵住的状态
被堵住的，无法通行的

senses.title: A solid piece of material
senses.definition: a solid piece with flat sides
senses.definitionCN: 有平面的坚实一块
senses.example: The wall was built from blocks of stone.
senses.exampleCN: 这堵墙是用一块块石头砌成的。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, a lump of wood or stone.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，指一块木头或石头。

senses.title: The area between streets
senses.definition: the group of buildings between two streets
senses.definitionCN: 两条街之间的一片建筑
senses.example: The school is two blocks away.
senses.exampleCN: 学校在两个街区之外。
senses.why: City blocks were shaped like the solid blocks of stone.
senses.whyCN: 城市街区就像一块块坚实的石料。

senses.title: Something in the way
senses.definition: something that stops movement through a passage
senses.definitionCN: 挡住通道、使无法通过的东西
senses.example: There was a block in the pipe.
senses.exampleCN: 管子里有一处堵塞。
senses.why: A solid lump in a passage stops what flows through it.
senses.whyCN: 通道里的一块实心物，会挡住流过去的东西。

senses.title: To stop movement through
senses.definition: to prevent something from passing
senses.definitionCN: 使某物无法通过
senses.example: A fallen tree blocked the narrow road.
senses.exampleCN: 一棵倒下的树挡住了窄路。
senses.why: The noun turned into the action of putting a block in the way.
senses.whyCN: 名词转成了「把障碍放到路上」这个动作。

intro.cn: block 来自一个表示树干或大块的荷兰语词。

items.en: block named a piece of wood or stone.
items.cn: block 指一块木头或石头。

items.en: block named a group of houses.
items.cn: block 开始指一片房屋。

items.en: to block became a common verb.
items.cn: 动词 block 成为常用说法。

items.en: block covers lumps, streets and stopping movement.
items.cn: 如今 block 兼指大块、街区与阻挡。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bl- and -ock shapes; the near-meaning group names bricks and barriers.
note.cn: 形近组共用 bl- 与 -ock 的形状；近义组是砖石与障碍类词。

normalIntro.cn: block 是一块既能砌墙、也能挡路的东西。

normal.en: A block of stone is the basic image.
normal.cn: a block of stone 是最基本的意象。

normal.en: Two blocks away is a common direction.

normal.en: Block the road uses the verb.

normal.en: A blockage stops a pipe.

normal.en: Black is a colour; block is a lump.

abstract.en: See square stones stacked by a wall.
abstract.cn: 想象墙边码着方形石块。

abstract.en: See a street corner with tall buildings.
abstract.cn: 想象街角立着高楼。

abstract.en: See a tree lying across a path.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵树横在小路上。

examples.en: The wall was built from blocks of stone.
examples.cn: 这堵墙是用一块块石头砌成的。

examples.en: A fallen tree blocked the narrow road.
examples.cn: 一棵倒下的树挡住了窄路。

dict_mnemonic.text: block 与 black 只差一个元音，黑色的石头码成一块块，就是 block。

root: block 源自中古荷兰语 blok（树干、大块），经古法语 bloc 进入英语，先指木石大块，十七世纪起指成片的房屋，十九世纪又发展出阻挡的动词义。

sensesIntro.en: A stone lump, a city square, an obstacle, and the act of stopping.
sensesIntro.cn: 一块石料、一个城市街区、一处障碍，以及阻挡的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: square stone blocks stacked beside a wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：墙边码着的方形石块。

intro.en: Block adds -age for a blockage and -ed for a blocked thing.
intro.cn: block 加 -age 构成堵塞名词，加 -ed 构成被堵的状态。

latinIntro.en: The base is Dutch; Latin items below are related in meaning.
latinIntro.cn: 词基来自荷兰语，下面的拉丁词只在意思上相关。

definition_en: a man, especially one that the speaker finds ordinary or likeable
core_image: 一个再普通不过的男人：蹲在路边修自行车，裤脚沾着机油
scene: 修车铺里，几个熟客围着那个蹲在地上给链条上油的男人说笑。The mechanic who fixes bicycles in the alley is a friendly bloke.
sceneCN: 这里 bloke 是「家伙、男人」（第 1 个义项：一个普通的男性）；句意是巷子里修自行车的那个机修工是个友善的家伙。

pos.zh: 家伙；男人；小伙子（英式口语，尤指普通人）

collocations.zh: 某个家伙；不知道是谁的男人

derivatives.zh: 由名词 bloke 加形容词后缀 -ish 构成，义为「像大老爷们儿的；男人气的」
bloke 的变体加 -ish 构成，义为「有男子汉做派的」

senses.title: A man, an ordinary male person
senses.definition: a man, especially one seen as ordinary, everyday, or easy to like
senses.definitionCN: 一个男人，尤指看起来普通、日常、让人容易有好感的男性
senses.example: He seemed like a decent bloke when we met at the pub.
senses.exampleCN: 我们在酒馆见面时，他看上去像个正派的家伙。
senses.why: The word began as slang for a stranger whose name nobody knew, then settled into a warm label for any man on the street.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初是指说不上名字的陌生男人，后来固定成对街头任何男性的一种带着好感的通俗称呼。

senses.title: A fellow of the speaker's own sort
senses.titleCN: 同类人；自己圈子里的人
senses.definition: a fellow belonging to the same group or sharing the speaker's way of life
senses.definitionCN: 与说话人同处一个圈子、生活方式相近的同伴
senses.example: The players welcomed the new bloke into the dressing room.
senses.exampleCN: 队员们把新来的这位迎进了更衣室。
senses.why: Because it names an unnamed male, it naturally marks him as one of us rather than an outsider.
senses.whyCN: 正因为它指「叫不上名字的男人」，它天然带有「自己人」的意味，把对方划进说话人的圈子里。

senses.title: A man referred to without naming him
senses.titleCN: 某个男人（不知名或懒得点名）
senses.definition: some man the speaker mentions without giving his name or identity
senses.definitionCN: 说话人提起来但不说出姓名或身份的某个男人
senses.example: Some bloke left his umbrella on the bus.
senses.exampleCN: 有个家伙把伞落在了公交车上。
senses.why: The vague origin of the word itself made it perfect for pointing at vague men.
senses.whyCN: 这个词自身的来历本就模糊，恰好适合用来指代身份不明的男人。

senses.title: Blokes as a collective, men in general
senses.definition: men in general, treated as a group, often contrasted with women
senses.definitionCN: 泛指男性群体，常与女性相对而提
senses.example: Down the pub, the blokes talk football all night.
senses.exampleCN: 在酒馆里，男人们整晚都在聊足球。
senses.why: Once the word means any man, the plural slides from individuals to men as a crowd.
senses.whyCN: 一旦单词可以指任何男人，复数形式便从一个个个体滑向「男人这个群体」。

senses.title: An Australian or British everyman hero
senses.titleCN: 普通人形象（澳、英文化中的平民典型）
senses.definition: in Australian and British culture, the image of the plain, honest, unpretentious man
senses.definitionCN: 在澳大利亚和英国文化中，指朴实、直率、不装腔作势的平民男子形象
senses.example: The advertisement showed a cheerful bloke in a flannel shirt.
senses.exampleCN: 广告里是一个穿法兰绒衬衫的开朗汉子。
senses.why: Cultures that prize egalitarianism turned the casual word into a positive emblem of ordinariness.
senses.whyCN: 崇尚平等的文化把这个随口的词变成了代表平凡本色的正面符号。

senses.title: A character type in fiction or comedy
senses.titleCN: 角色类型（文艺作品中的憨厚男人）
senses.definition: a stock character in stories or comedy, a plain man coping with everyday trouble
senses.definitionCN: 小说或喜剧中的一种固定角色：一个应付日常琐事的憨直男人
senses.example: The sitcom's main bloke keeps burning his own toast.
senses.exampleCN: 这部情景喜剧的主角总是把自己家的吐司烤糊。
senses.why: The warm, unglamorous flavor of the word suits comic characters built on ordinariness.
senses.whyCN: 这个词亲切而不光鲜的味道，正好契合以平凡制造笑点的喜剧角色。

senses.title: A boyfriend or husband in casual talk
senses.definition: in casual British speech, a woman's boyfriend or husband mentioned offhandedly
senses.definitionCN: 英式口语中，女性随口提到的男朋友或丈夫
senses.example: She brought her bloke to the family dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 她把男朋友带来了家宴。
senses.why: Pointing at a man without naming him works naturally for the man in one's life.
senses.whyCN: 既然可以不点名地指一个男人，那么拿来随口称呼自己生命里那个男人也十分顺口。

senses.title: Emphatic or ironic use for any person facing trouble
senses.titleCN: 强调或反讽用法（指遭遇麻烦的任何人）
senses.definition: used emphatically or ironically for anyone caught in an awkward situation, regardless of gender nuance
senses.definitionCN: 以强调或反讽口吻指陷入尴尬处境的任何人，性别色彩淡化
senses.example: Poor bloke, he locked himself out again.
senses.exampleCN: 这可怜的家伙，他又把自己锁在门外了。
senses.why: The affectionate tone lets speakers extend sympathy to anyone, male or not.
senses.whyCN: 亲切的语气让说话人可以把这份同情延伸到任何人身上，性别色彩因此淡出。

intro.en: Bloke is a nineteenth-century British slang word whose origin remains genuinely uncertain; several rival hypotheses exist and none has been proven.
intro.cn: bloke 是十九世纪的英国俚语，来源至今确实不确定；存在几种相互竞争的假说，均未被证实。

items.en: First recorded in British slang around the 1840s, meaning a man whose name is unknown, an outsider, a stranger.
items.cn: 约在十九世纪四十年代首次见于英国俚语，指叫不上名字的男人、外来者、陌生人。

items.en: One widely repeated account links it to Shelta, the cant of Irish Travellers; the link is plausible but not proven.
items.cn: 一种流传较广的说法把它与爱尔兰游居者的隐语 Shelta 联系起来；这一关联合理但未被证实。

items.en: Another hypothesis derives it from a Romani word for a man; scholars treat this as speculative.
items.cn: 另一说认为它源自某个吉卜赛语（罗姆语）中表示「男人」的词；学界视之为推测。

items.en: The word spread to Australia, where it gained a warm, egalitarian flavor and became a cultural emblem of the ordinary man.
items.cn: 这个词传入澳大利亚，带上亲切、平等的意味，成为平民男子形象的文化符号。

items.en: In twentieth-century Britain the harsh early sense faded, leaving a friendly everyday word for any man.
items.cn: 二十世纪的英国，早期生硬的「外来者」义逐渐消退，留下对任何男人的日常亲切称呼。

items.en: Today bloke is chiefly British and Australian colloquial usage; American English prefers other words for the same idea.
items.cn: 如今 bloke 主要用于英式和澳式口语；美式英语表达同样意思时更常用其他词。

note.en: Bloke has no known relatives, so the look-alike group gathers casual male-nouns from Britain and America, and the near-meaning group gathers everyday words for men.
note.cn: bloke 没有已知的同族词，形近一组收录英美口语中的男性称呼，近义一组收录表示男人的日常词汇。

normalIntro.en: Five honest ways to remember bloke, none of them pretending to be etymology.
normalIntro.cn: 五种朴素的记忆法；它们只是联想，不是词源考证。

normal.en: bloke sounds like "block"; picture a man sitting on a block of stone in the street.
normal.cn: bloke 与 block（块）发音相近：想象一个男人蹲在街头的一块石墩上。

normal.en: b + loke: he locks his bike, a very ordinary thing a very ordinary man does.
normal.cn: b + lock（锁）：他锁上自行车，普通人常做的普通事。

normal.en: the plural blokes rhymes with folks; blokes are just folks who are men.
normal.cn: 复数 blokes 与 folks（人们）押韵：blokes 不过是「人们」中的男性。

normal.en: British sitcoms are full of blokes; recall any comic character you have seen.
normal.cn: 英式情景喜剧里满是 bloke：回忆你见过的任何一个憨直男角色。

normal.en: o in bloke is round like a friendly face; the word itself carries warmth.
normal.cn: bloke 中的 o 圆圆的像一张友善的脸；这个词自带亲切感。

abstract.en: Picture an ordinary man fixing a bicycle, oil on his hands, smiling.
abstract.cn: 想象一个普通男人在修自行车，手上沾着机油，面带微笑。

abstract.en: Think of the feeling of calling someone by no name at all, just warmly.
abstract.cn: 体会那种不叫名字、只是亲切地称呼一个人的感觉。

abstract.en: Link the word to the smell of a pub: wood, beer, and easy laughter.
abstract.cn: 把这个词和酒馆的气味连起来：木头、啤酒和轻松的笑声。

examples.en: The plumber who fixed our sink was a friendly bloke.
examples.cn: 来修水池的水管工是个友善的家伙。

examples.en: Some bloke on the train gave up his seat for the old lady.
examples.cn: 火车上有个家伙给老太太让了座。

examples.en: British comedies often show a bloke struggling with ordinary life.
examples.cn: 英式喜剧常常刻画与平凡生活较劲的男人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不乐哥」——那个不太爱笑的家伙蹲在路口修车，路过的街坊都喊他「不乐哥」，可喊多了他自己也乐了。

root: 来源不确定。一般认为 bloke 于十九世纪四十年代出现在英国俚语中，可能源自爱尔兰游居者隐语 Shelta，或与罗姆语中表示「男人」的词有关，均属假说，不可当作定论。

sensesIntro.en: From an unnamed stranger to a warm everyday label, the word now covers any man, the group of men, a cultural type, and even affectionate or ironic uses.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一个叫不上名字的陌生人出发，这个词如今可以指任何男人、男人群体、文化中的平民形象，甚至带亲切或反讽色彩的随口称呼。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an ordinary man you point at without knowing his name
core.cn: 核心意象：一个你说不上名字、随手一指的普通男人

branches.en: the base label for any man on the street
branches.cn: 对街头任何男性的基本称呼

branches.en: from one of us to men as a whole crowd
branches.cn: 从「自己人」扩展到整个男性群体

branches.en: pointing at a man without naming him, including one's partner
branches.cn: 不点名地指男人，包括随口称呼伴侣

branches.en: the everyman image in culture and comedy
branches.cn: 文化与喜剧中的平民男人形象

branches.en: sympathy or irony stretched to anyone in trouble
branches.cn: 同情或反讽延伸到陷入麻烦的任何人

intro.en: Bloke has no prefixes or suffixes of its own; the items below are related casual male-nouns and nearby formations that help place it in the slang family.
intro.cn: bloke 本身没有前缀后缀；下面收录相关的口语男性称呼及邻近构词，帮助把它放进口语词族的坐标系。

latinIntro.en: No Latin relatives are known for this word, so the Latin family list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 该词没有已知的拉丁同族词，故拉丁同源词一栏为空。

items.example: That guy at the counter helped me.

items.example: A kind fellow showed me the way.
items.exampleCN: 一位好心人给我指了路。

items.exampleCN: 那个小伙子经营一家小店。
谢了，伙计，你帮了我大忙。

items.example: The blokes watched the match together.

items.meaningCN: 像典型男人的；男人气的
items.example: His blokish jokes filled the room.
items.exampleCN: 他那男人气的笑话逗笑了全场。
她喜欢他那种平民汉子的魅力。
childish（幼稚的）、foolish（愚蠢的）、blokish（男人气的）

bloke 变体加 -ish 构成，义为「平民男子做派的」

definition_zh: 金发的（多指女性）；金发女郎
definition_en: having pale yellow hair
core_image: 阳光下发亮的浅金色长发
scene: 阳光落在她的浅金色长发上。The blonde girl waved from the corner.
sceneCN: 这里 blonde 是「金发的」（第 1 个义项：头发呈浅黄色，多形容女性）；句意是那个金发女孩在街角挥手。

pos.zh: 形容词：金发的，多用于形容女性

derivatives.zh: 金发的，拼写少一个 e，多用于形容男性
偏金黄的，颜色接近金发的

senses.title: Having pale yellow hair
senses.definition: having hair of a pale yellow colour
senses.definitionCN: 头发呈浅黄色的
senses.example: The blonde girl waved from the corner.
senses.exampleCN: 那个金发女孩在街角挥手。
senses.why: This is the central sense, borrowed from French for fair hair.
senses.whyCN: 这是核心义项，借自法语中形容浅色头发的词。

senses.title: A woman with fair hair
senses.definition: a woman whose hair is pale yellow
senses.definitionCN: 头发呈浅黄色的女子
senses.example: A blonde sat at the piano.
senses.exampleCN: 一位金发女子坐在钢琴前。
senses.why: The adjective became a noun for the person described.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转为名词，直接指被形容的人。

intro.en: Blonde came from French and kept a feminine spelling in English.
intro.cn: blonde 来自法语，在英语里保留了阴性拼写。

items.en: blundus meant a light yellow colour.
items.cn: blundus 意为浅黄色。

items.en: blond named fair hair.
items.cn: blond 指浅色的头发。

items.en: English kept blond for men and blonde for women.
items.cn: 英语用 blond 指男性，用 blonde 指女性。

items.en: blonde also named a fair-haired woman.
items.cn: blonde 也用来指金发女子。

items.en: the spelling blonde is mostly used of women.
items.cn: 如今 blonde 这种拼写多用于女性。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the bl- and -ond shapes; the near-meaning group names fair colours.
note.cn: 形近组共用 bl- 与 -ond 的形状；近义组是表示浅色的词。

normalIntro.en: Blonde is the feminine spelling of a word for fair hair.
normalIntro.cn: blonde 是表示金发的词里带阴性色彩的那种拼写。

normal.en: Blonde usually describes a woman.
normal.cn: blonde 通常形容女性。

normal.en: Blond with no e is used of men.
normal.cn: 不带 e 的 blond 多用于男性。

normal.en: Blonde can also be a noun.
normal.cn: blonde 也可以作名词。

normal.en: The plural adds s.
normal.cn: 复数加 s。

normal.en: Blonde and blind differ in two letters.
normal.cn: blonde 与 blind 相差两个字母。

abstract.en: See pale gold hair in afternoon sun.
abstract.cn: 想象午后阳光下的浅金色头发。

abstract.en: See a woman turning at a street corner.
abstract.cn: 想象一位女子在街角转身。

abstract.en: See light strands lifted by wind.
abstract.cn: 想象发丝被风轻轻吹起。

examples.en: The blonde girl waved from the corner.
examples.cn: 那个金发女孩在街角挥手。

examples.en: A blonde sat at the piano.
examples.cn: 一位金发女子坐在钢琴前。

examples.en: She has long blonde hair.
examples.cn: 她有一头金色长发。

dict_mnemonic.text: blonde 比 blond 多一个 e，字母 e 常带阴性色彩，所以 blonde 多指金发女子。

root: blonde 经法语 blond 来自中世纪拉丁语 blundus（浅黄色），英语保留了阴性拼写 blonde，多用于女性；不带 e 的 blond 多用于男性。

sensesIntro.en: A hair colour, and then the woman who has it.
sensesIntro.cn: 先是一种发色，再指拥有这种发色的女子。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: pale gold hair shining in the sun.
core.cn: 核心意象：阳光下泛着浅金色的长发。

intro.en: Blonde pairs with the masculine spelling blond and adds -ish.
intro.cn: blonde 与阳性拼写 blond 成对，并可加 -ish。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin blundus by way of French.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 blundus，经法语传入。
